Conduct subsequent measurement for leases from the perspective of lessee and lessor
Identify the circumstances for derecognition of leases and the accounting treatment
Discuss the disclosure requirements for lease variations
Analyze, critically evaluate and interpret issues in accounting for leases
ms: Lakukan pengukuran awal pajakan dari perspektif lessee dan lessor
Lakukan pengukuran selepas pengiktirafan pajakan dari perspektif lessee dan lessor
Kenal pasti keadaan nyahpengiktirafan pajakan dan layanan perakaunan
Analisis, nilai secara kritikal dan tafsir isu perakaunan pajakan

en: From **1 January 2019**, **MFRS 16 Leases** applies. It equals **IFRS 16** and **replaces MFRS 117** (used since 2012).
It covers recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure of leases in the books of the **lessor** and the **lessee**.
**Main change:** a **single lessee accounting model**: the lessee may need to recognise almost all leases on the balance sheet.
ms: Mulai **1 Januari 2019**, **MFRS 16 Leases** terpakai. Ia sama dengan **IFRS 16** dan **menggantikan MFRS 117** (digunakan sejak 2012).
Ia meliputi pengiktirafan, pengukuran, pembentangan dan pendedahan pajakan dalam rekod **pemberi pajak (lessor)** dan **pemajak (lessee)**.
**Perubahan utama:** **model perakaunan lessee tunggal**: lessee mungkin perlu mengiktiraf hampir semua pajakan dalam kunci kira-kira.

blocks.en: Memory hook: LESSOR = owner who lets (Lets out). LESSEE = user who rents (Rents).
blocks.ms: Cara ingat: LESSOR = pemilik yang memajakkan. LESSEE = pengguna yang menyewa.

en: Periodic receipts give interest revenue; retains ownership of the asset; boosts sales
ms: Penerimaan berkala beri hasil faedah; mengekalkan pemilikan aset; meningkatkan jualan

en: Flexibility in using assets; less costly financing
ms: Fleksibiliti menggunakan aset; pembiayaan kurang mahal

en: **Information technology:** quickly adapt to technology changes.
**Transportation:** huge financial commitments; leasing is a good financing option.
**Construction and agriculture:** reduces the chance of assets sitting idle in some periods.
ms: **Teknologi maklumat:** cepat menyesuaikan diri dengan perubahan teknologi.
**Pengangkutan:** komitmen kewangan besar; pajakan ialah pilihan pembiayaan yang baik.
**Pembinaan dan pertanian:** mengurangkan kemungkinan aset terbiar pada tempoh tertentu.

en: Transfers **substantially all risks and rewards** incidental to ownership to the lessee (title may or may not transfer)
A lease **other than a finance lease**: risks and rewards are **not** transferred
ms: Memindahkan **hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran** pemilikan kepada lessee (hak milik mungkin atau tidak berpindah)
Pajakan **selain pajakan kewangan**: risiko dan ganjaran **tidak** dipindahkan

en: Lessee = **beneficial owner**; lessor holds legal title (legal form)
ms: Lessee = **pemilik benefisial**; lessor pegang hak milik sah (bentuk undang-undang)

blocks.en: Extra (para 63 examples of a finance lease): ownership transfers at end of term; a bargain purchase option is reasonably certain; lease term is a major part of the asset's economic life; PV of lease payments is substantially all of fair value; the asset is so specialised that only the lessee can use it. These are indicators: use judgement (substance over form).
blocks.ms: Tambahan (contoh pajakan kewangan para 63): pemilikan berpindah pada akhir tempoh; opsyen belian murah hampir pasti; tempoh pajakan ialah sebahagian besar hayat ekonomi aset; PV bayaran pajakan hampir keseluruhan nilai saksama; aset begitu khusus hingga hanya lessee boleh guna. Ini petunjuk: guna pertimbangan (substansi mengatasi bentuk).

blocks.en: Finance lease (as on the slides)
blocks.ms: Pajakan kewangan (seperti dalam slide)

en: Recognise the **leased asset according to its use** (e.g. PPE or intangible).
**Subsequently:** periodic **lease instalment payments** and **depreciation/amortisation** (for assets with definite useful life).
ms: Iktiraf **aset pajakan mengikut kegunaannya** (cth PPE atau aset tak ketara).
**Selepas itu:** **bayaran ansuran pajakan** berkala dan **susut nilai/pelunasan** (untuk aset hayat berguna terhad).

blocks.en: Operating lease (as on the slides)
blocks.ms: Pajakan operasi (seperti dalam slide)

blocks.en: Recognise lease payments **on a straight-line basis over the lease term**.
blocks.ms: Iktiraf bayaran pajakan **secara garis lurus sepanjang tempoh pajakan**.

blocks.en: IMPORTANT (MFRS 16 as actually issued, slides 5 and 23): the lessee uses a SINGLE model. Almost all leases are recognised as a right-of-use (ROU) asset and a lease liability. The straight-line expense treatment applies only to the exemptions: short-term leases (12 months or less) and low-value assets. The finance/operating split matters mainly to the LESSOR. Ask your lecturer which treatment your exam expects.
blocks.ms: PENTING (MFRS 16 sebenar, slide 5 dan 23): lessee guna SATU model. Hampir semua pajakan diiktiraf sebagai aset hak guna (ROU) dan liabiliti pajakan. Layanan belanja garis lurus hanya untuk pengecualian: pajakan jangka pendek (12 bulan atau kurang) dan aset bernilai rendah. Pembahagian kewangan/operasi penting terutama kepada LESSOR. Tanya pensyarah layanan mana yang exam jangka.

blocks.en: Numbers are invented for practice: the slides give no figures (the textbook examples 7.2–7.7 are class exercises).
blocks.ms: Nombor direka untuk latihan: slide tiada angka (contoh buku teks 7.2–7.7 ialah latihan kelas).

blocks.en: A lessee signs a 3-year lease starting 1 January 20x1. Annual payment RM10,000 at each year-end. Interest rate implicit in the lease 8%. Straight-line depreciation over the lease term, no residual value.
blocks.ms: Lessee tandatangan pajakan 3 tahun bermula 1 Januari 20x1. Bayaran tahunan RM10,000 pada setiap hujung tahun. Kadar faedah tersirat 8%. Susut nilai garis lurus sepanjang tempoh pajakan, tiada nilai sisa.

blocks.en: Year-3 interest (740) is the balancing figure so the liability ends at zero (rounding). Total interest = 3 × 10,000 − 25,771 = 4,229 (= 2,062 + 1,427 + 740). P/L in year 1 = interest 2,062 + depreciation 8,590 = 10,652 (front-loaded vs 10,000 under the old operating-lease expense).
blocks.ms: Faedah tahun 3 (740) ialah angka pelaras supaya liabiliti berakhir sifar (pembundaran). Jumlah faedah = 3 × 10,000 − 25,771 = 4,229 (= 2,062 + 1,427 + 740). P/L tahun 1 = faedah 2,062 + susut nilai 8,590 = 10,652 (lebih awal berbanding 10,000 di bawah belanja pajakan operasi lama).

blocks.en: Finance lease
blocks.ms: Pajakan kewangan

en: Recognise a **lease receivable** equal to the **net investment in the lease**.
**Subsequently:** periodic receipts include **principal receipt** and **finance income**.
ms: Iktiraf **belum terima pajakan** sama dengan **pelaburan bersih dalam pajakan**.
**Selepas itu:** penerimaan berkala termasuk **penerimaan prinsipal** dan **pendapatan kewangan**.

blocks.en: Operating lease
blocks.ms: Pajakan operasi

en: Lessor **continues to measure the leased asset** according to its nature (e.g. PPE).
**Costs of earning lease income** (e.g. depreciation) are expensed.
Recognise **lease income on a straight-line basis** over the lease term.
ms: Lessor **terus mengukur aset pajakan** mengikut sifatnya (cth PPE).
**Kos memperoleh pendapatan pajakan** (cth susut nilai) dibelanjakan.
Iktiraf **pendapatan pajakan secara garis lurus** sepanjang tempoh pajakan.

en: **General description** of the leasing arrangement: basis for determining rent, renewal or purchase options, restrictions.
**Finance leases:** reconciliation of **future minimum lease payments** and their **present value**, by the period when due.
**Operating leases:** **future minimum lease payments** under **non-cancellable** operating leases in aggregate and for each stated period.
ms: **Penerangan am** pengaturan pajakan: asas menentukan sewa, opsyen pembaharuan atau pembelian, sekatan.
**Pajakan kewangan:** penyesuaian **bayaran pajakan minimum masa depan** dan **nilai kini**nya, mengikut tempoh matang.
**Pajakan operasi:** **bayaran pajakan minimum masa depan** di bawah pajakan operasi **tidak boleh dibatalkan** secara agregat dan bagi setiap tempoh dinyatakan.

blocks.en: Wording follows MFRS 117. MFRS 16 requires a maturity analysis of lease liabilities, ROU asset and depreciation disclosures, and interest expense (extra).
blocks.ms: Susunan kata ikut MFRS 117. MFRS 16 mewajibkan analisis kematangan liabiliti pajakan, pendedahan aset ROU dan susut nilai, dan belanja faedah (tambahan).

en: The **building** is a finance or operating lease by the usual tests.
**Land** (indefinite economic life) is normally an **operating lease**, unless **title passes** to the lessee at the end of the term.
If lease payments **cannot be allocated reliably** between land and building, treat **both** as a finance or operating lease.
ms: **Bangunan** ialah pajakan kewangan atau operasi mengikut ujian biasa.
**Tanah** (hayat ekonomi tidak terhad) biasanya **pajakan operasi**, kecuali **hak milik berpindah** kepada lessee pada akhir tempoh.
Jika bayaran pajakan **tidak boleh diagihkan dengan pasti** antara tanah dan bangunan, layan **kedua-duanya** sebagai pajakan kewangan atau operasi.

blocks.en: A manufacturer or dealer lessor in a finance lease recognises **a sale** plus **finance income**:
blocks.ms: Lessor pengilang atau peniaga dalam pajakan kewangan mengiktiraf **jualan** serta **pendapatan kewangan**:

en: Lower of fair value and PV of minimum lease payments
ms: Lebih rendah antara nilai saksama dan PV bayaran pajakan minimum

en: Cost − PV of unguaranteed residual value
ms: Kos − PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin

blocks.en: Practice (own numbers): fair value RM100,000; PV of minimum lease payments RM95,000; asset cost RM80,000; PV of unguaranteed residual value RM5,000.
blocks.ms: Latihan (nombor sendiri): nilai saksama RM100,000; PV bayaran pajakan minimum RM95,000; kos aset RM80,000; PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin RM5,000.

blocks.en: Sale price = lower of 100,000 and 95,000 = 95,000. Cost of sales = 80,000 − 5,000 = 75,000. Gross profit = 20,000. Lease receivable = 95,000.
blocks.ms: Harga jualan = lebih rendah antara 100,000 dan 95,000 = 95,000. Kos jualan = 80,000 − 5,000 = 75,000. Untung kasar = 20,000. Belum terima pajakan = 95,000.

en: Record sale proceeds; write off carrying amount; recognise deferred profit/loss. Recognise lease asset and lease liability. Recognise interest expense and principal payment, depreciation, and amortisation of deferred profit/loss.

Step 1: compare FV with carrying amount (CA); if FV < CA, write the asset down to FV. Step 2: compare selling price (SP) and FV; gain or loss is recognised immediately or deferred and amortised. Recognise rental expense over the lease term.
ms: Rekod hasil jualan; hapus kira amaun dibawa; iktiraf untung/rugi tertunda. Iktiraf aset pajakan dan liabiliti pajakan. Iktiraf belanja faedah dan bayaran prinsipal, susut nilai, dan pelunasan untung/rugi tertunda.

Langkah 1: banding FV dengan amaun dibawa (CA); jika FV < CA, tulis turun aset kepada FV. Langkah 2: banding harga jualan (SP) dan FV; untung atau rugi diiktiraf serta-merta atau ditangguh dan dilunaskan. Iktiraf belanja sewa sepanjang tempoh pajakan.

en: Record payment for purchase (and asset). Recognise lease receivable. Recognise interest income and principal receipt.
Recognise the asset at fair value. Recognise lease rental income over the lease term. Recognise depreciation.
ms: Rekod bayaran belian (dan aset). Iktiraf belum terima pajakan. Iktiraf pendapatan faedah dan penerimaan prinsipal.
Iktiraf aset pada nilai saksama. Iktiraf pendapatan sewa pajakan sepanjang tempoh pajakan. Iktiraf susut nilai.

blocks.en: This table is the textbook (MFRS 117-style) treatment. Under IFRS 16 / MFRS 16, the sale must satisfy MFRS 15 as a sale; otherwise the transfer is a financing (slide 24).
blocks.ms: Jadual ini layanan buku teks (gaya MFRS 117). Di bawah IFRS 16 / MFRS 16, jualan mesti memenuhi MFRS 15 sebagai jualan; jika tidak, pemindahan ialah pembiayaan (slide 24).

blocks.en: Substance over form
blocks.ms: Substansi mengatasi bentuk

blocks.en: Lease accounting applies **substance over form**: the economic substance is whether the **risks and rewards of ownership** are transferred to the lessee or remain with the lessor.
blocks.ms: Perakaunan pajakan guna **substansi mengatasi bentuk**: substansi ekonomi ialah sama ada **risiko dan ganjaran pemilikan** dipindahkan kepada lessee atau kekal dengan lessor.

blocks.en: IFRS 16 / MFRS 16
blocks.ms: IFRS 16 / MFRS 16

en: **Single lessee model** based on the **right-of-use** model.
Effect: lessee recognises **all leases as finance-type leases**, except **short-term** and **low-value** leases.
Need to distinguish a **lease contract from a service contract**.
**Sale and leaseback:** the sale must meet the requirements of the revenue standard (IFRS 15 / MFRS 15).
ms: Kesan: lessee mengiktiraf **semua pajakan sebagai jenis kewangan**, kecuali pajakan **jangka pendek** dan **bernilai rendah**.
Perlu membezakan **kontrak pajakan daripada kontrak perkhidmatan**.
Model hak guna terpakai juga untuk **sub-pajakan**.
**Jual dan pajak balik:** jualan mesti memenuhi keperluan piawaian hasil (IFRS 15 / MFRS 15).

blocks.en: Why it matters: before IFRS 16, operating leases kept debt off the balance sheet, so gearing looked lower than reality.
blocks.ms: Kenapa penting: sebelum IFRS 16, pajakan operasi mengekalkan hutang di luar kunci kira-kira, jadi nisbah hutang nampak lebih rendah daripada realiti.

q.en: When did MFRS 16 start and what did it replace?
q.ms: Bila MFRS 16 bermula dan apa digantikan?

a.en: 1 January 2019; replaces MFRS 117 Leases (equivalent to IFRS 16).
a.ms: 1 Januari 2019; menggantikan MFRS 117 Leases (sama dengan IFRS 16).

q.en: Main change under MFRS 16
q.ms: Perubahan utama MFRS 16

a.en: Single lessee accounting model: lessee recognises almost all leases on the balance sheet. Lessor accounting is largely unchanged.
a.ms: Model perakaunan lessee tunggal: lessee mengiktiraf hampir semua pajakan dalam kunci kira-kira. Perakaunan lessor hampir tidak berubah.

q.en: Advantages of leasing for the lessee
q.ms: Kelebihan pajakan untuk lessee

a.en: Flexibility in using assets; less costly financing.
a.ms: Fleksibiliti menggunakan aset; pembiayaan kurang mahal.

q.en: Advantages of leasing for the lessor
q.ms: Kelebihan pajakan untuk lessor

a.en: Interest revenue from periodic receipts; retains ownership; boosts sales.
a.ms: Hasil faedah daripada penerimaan berkala; kekal pemilik; tingkatkan jualan.

q.en: Define a finance lease
q.ms: Takrifkan pajakan kewangan

a.en: Transfers substantially all risks and rewards incidental to ownership to the lessee (title may or may not transfer).
a.ms: Memindahkan hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran pemilikan kepada lessee (hak milik mungkin atau tidak berpindah).

q.en: Define an operating lease
q.ms: Takrifkan pajakan operasi

a.en: Any lease other than a finance lease: risks and rewards are not transferred; lessor is legal and beneficial owner.
a.ms: Mana-mana pajakan selain pajakan kewangan: risiko dan ganjaran tidak dipindahkan; lessor pemilik sah dan benefisial.

q.en: Finance lease: who is the beneficial owner?
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan: siapa pemilik benefisial?

a.en: The lessee, even though legal title is with the lessor.
a.ms: Lessee, walaupun hak milik sah di tangan lessor.

q.en: Lessee finance lease: initial recognition
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan lessee: pengiktirafan awal

a.en: At the commencement date: recognise the leased asset (by its use) and the lease liability.
a.ms: Pada tarikh permulaan: iktiraf aset pajakan (mengikut kegunaan) dan liabiliti pajakan.

q.en: Lessee finance lease: subsequent
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan lessee: selepas pengiktirafan

a.en: Lease instalment payments (interest + principal) and depreciation/amortisation.
a.ms: Bayaran ansuran pajakan (faedah + prinsipal) dan susut nilai/pelunasan.

q.en: Lessee operating lease (slide version)
q.ms: Pajakan operasi lessee (versi slide)

a.en: Recognise lease payments straight-line over the lease term.
a.ms: Iktiraf bayaran pajakan garis lurus sepanjang tempoh pajakan.

q.en: MFRS 16 lessee exemptions
q.ms: Pengecualian lessee MFRS 16

a.en: Short-term leases (12 months or less) and low-value assets: expense on a straight-line basis.
a.ms: Pajakan jangka pendek (12 bulan atau kurang) dan aset bernilai rendah: belanja garis lurus.

q.en: Initial journal under the MFRS 16 lessee model
q.ms: Jurnal awal model lessee MFRS 16

a.en: Dr Right-of-use asset; Cr Lease liability (PV of lease payments).
a.ms: Dr Aset hak guna; Cr Liabiliti pajakan (PV bayaran pajakan).

q.en: Lease liability instalment journal
q.ms: Jurnal ansuran liabiliti pajakan

a.en: Dr Interest expense; Dr Lease liability (principal); Cr Bank.
a.ms: Dr Belanja faedah; Dr Liabiliti pajakan (prinsipal); Cr Bank.

q.en: Interest on a lease liability
q.ms: Faedah atas liabiliti pajakan

a.en: Opening liability × interest rate (e.g. 25,771 × 8% = 2,062).
a.ms: Liabiliti awal × kadar faedah (cth 25,771 × 8% = 2,062).

q.en: Lessor finance lease: initial recognition
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan lessor: pengiktirafan awal

a.en: At inception: lease receivable = net investment in the lease.
a.ms: Pada permulaan: belum terima pajakan = pelaburan bersih dalam pajakan.

q.en: Lessor finance lease: receipts
q.ms: Pajakan kewangan lessor: penerimaan

a.en: Each receipt = principal receipt + finance income.
a.ms: Setiap penerimaan = penerimaan prinsipal + pendapatan kewangan.

q.en: Lessor operating lease
q.ms: Pajakan operasi lessor

a.en: Keep the asset and depreciate it; recognise lease income straight-line over the term.
a.ms: Kekalkan aset dan susutnilaikannya; iktiraf pendapatan pajakan garis lurus sepanjang tempoh.

q.en: Disclosure for finance leases
q.ms: Pendedahan pajakan kewangan

a.en: Reconciliation of future minimum lease payments to present value, by due period.
a.ms: Penyesuaian bayaran pajakan minimum masa depan kepada nilai kini, mengikut tempoh matang.

q.en: Disclosure for operating leases
q.ms: Pendedahan pajakan operasi

a.en: Future minimum payments under non-cancellable operating leases, in aggregate and by period.
a.ms: Bayaran minimum masa depan di bawah pajakan operasi tidak boleh dibatalkan, secara agregat dan mengikut tempoh.

q.en: Land and building leases
q.ms: Pajakan tanah dan bangunan

a.en: Classify separately: building as finance/operating; land normally operating unless title passes. If payments cannot be allocated, treat both together.
a.ms: Klasifikasi berasingan: bangunan kewangan/operasi; tanah biasanya operasi kecuali hak milik berpindah. Jika bayaran tidak boleh diagih, layan kedua-duanya bersama.

q.en: Dealer lessor: sale price
q.ms: Lessor peniaga: harga jualan

a.en: Lower of fair value and PV of minimum lease payments.
a.ms: Lebih rendah antara nilai saksama dan PV bayaran pajakan minimum.

q.en: Dealer lessor: cost of sales
q.ms: Lessor peniaga: kos jualan

a.en: Cost − PV of unguaranteed residual value.
a.ms: Kos − PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin.

q.en: Sale and leaseback (operating): step 1
q.ms: Jual dan pajak balik (operasi): langkah 1

a.en: Compare FV with carrying amount; if FV < CA, write the asset down to FV.
a.ms: Banding FV dengan amaun dibawa; jika FV < CA, tulis turun aset kepada FV.

q.en: Sale and leaseback (operating): step 2
q.ms: Jual dan pajak balik (operasi): langkah 2

a.en: Compare selling price with FV; gain/loss recognised immediately or deferred and amortised.
a.ms: Banding harga jualan dengan FV; untung/rugi diiktiraf serta-merta atau ditangguh dan dilunaskan.

q.en: Substance over form in leases
q.ms: Substansi mengatasi bentuk dalam pajakan

a.en: Classify by whether risks and rewards of ownership transfer, not by legal title.
a.ms: Klasifikasi ikut sama ada risiko dan ganjaran pemilikan berpindah, bukan hak milik sah.

q.en: In a finance lease the lessor recognises at inception:
q.ms: Dalam pajakan kewangan lessor mengiktiraf pada permulaan:

o: Lease receivable equal to the net investment in the lease

e.en: Lease receivable = net investment in the lease.
e.ms: Belum terima pajakan = pelaburan bersih dalam pajakan.

q.en: Each periodic receipt in a lessor's finance lease includes:
q.ms: Setiap penerimaan berkala dalam pajakan kewangan lessor termasuk:

e.en: Principal receipt + finance income.
e.ms: Penerimaan prinsipal + pendapatan kewangan.

q.en: In an operating lease the lessor:
q.ms: Dalam pajakan operasi lessor:

o: Continues to depreciate the asset and recognises income straight-line

e.en: Asset stays; depreciation expensed; income straight-line.
e.ms: Aset kekal; susut nilai dibelanjakan; pendapatan garis lurus.

q.en: For finance leases the lessee must disclose a reconciliation of:
q.ms: Bagi pajakan kewangan lessee mesti dedah penyesuaian:

o: Future minimum lease payments to their present value

e.en: Reconciliation of future minimum lease payments and present value.
e.ms: Penyesuaian bayaran pajakan minimum masa depan dan nilai kini.

q.en: For operating leases, disclose future minimum lease payments under:
q.ms: Bagi pajakan operasi, dedah bayaran pajakan minimum masa depan di bawah:

e.en: Non-cancellable operating leases.
e.ms: Pajakan operasi tidak boleh dibatalkan.

q.en: In a lease of land and a building, the land is normally:
q.ms: Dalam pajakan tanah dan bangunan, tanah biasanya:

e.en: Land has an indefinite life: normally operating unless title passes.
e.ms: Tanah hayat tidak terhad: biasanya operasi kecuali hak milik berpindah.

q.en: If lease payments cannot be reliably allocated between land and building:
q.ms: Jika bayaran pajakan tidak boleh diagih dengan pasti antara tanah dan bangunan:

o: Treat both as a finance or operating lease

e.en: Treat both together as a finance or operating lease.
e.ms: Layan kedua-duanya bersama sebagai pajakan kewangan atau operasi.

q.en: A dealer lessor: fair value RM100,000; PV of minimum lease payments RM95,000. The sale price recognised is:
q.ms: Lessor peniaga: nilai saksama RM100,000; PV bayaran pajakan minimum RM95,000. Harga jualan diiktiraf:

e.en: Lower of FV and PV of MLP = 95,000.
e.ms: Lebih rendah antara FV dan PV MLP = 95,000.

q.en: Same dealer: cost RM80,000; PV of unguaranteed residual value RM5,000. Gross profit is:
q.ms: Peniaga sama: kos RM80,000; PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin RM5,000. Untung kasar:

q.en: In a sale and leaseback treated as an operating lease (textbook), step 1 compares:
q.ms: Dalam jual dan pajak balik dilayan sebagai pajakan operasi (buku teks), langkah 1 membandingkan:

e.en: If FV < CA, write the asset down to FV.
e.ms: Jika FV < CA, tulis turun aset kepada FV.

q.en: Under IFRS 16, a sale and leaseback requires that the sale:
q.ms: Di bawah IFRS 16, jual dan pajak balik memerlukan jualan itu:

o: Meets the revenue standard (IFRS 15) as a sale

e.en: The transfer must qualify as a sale under IFRS 15.
e.ms: Pemindahan mesti layak sebagai jualan di bawah IFRS 15.

q.en: Lease classification is an example of the principle of:
q.ms: Pengelasan pajakan ialah contoh prinsip:

e.en: Risks and rewards, not legal title.
e.ms: Risiko dan ganjaran, bukan hak milik sah.

q.en: IFRS 16 was introduced mainly to address:
q.ms: IFRS 16 diperkenalkan terutamanya untuk menangani:

e.en: It brings leases onto the lessee's balance sheet.
e.ms: Ia membawa pajakan ke dalam kunci kira-kira lessee.

q.en: Distinguish between a finance lease and an operating lease, and explain why classification relies on substance over form.
q.ms: Bezakan pajakan kewangan dan pajakan operasi, dan terangkan kenapa pengelasan bergantung pada substansi mengatasi bentuk.

en: Finance lease: transfers substantially all risks and rewards to the lessee (1)
Title may or may not transfer; lessee is beneficial owner (1)
Operating lease: any other lease; risks and rewards stay with the lessor (1)
Lessor is legal and beneficial owner in an operating lease (1)
Substance over form: economic reality (risks and rewards) over legal title (2)
ms: Pajakan kewangan: memindahkan hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran kepada lessee (1)
Hak milik mungkin atau tidak berpindah; lessee pemilik benefisial (1)
Pajakan operasi: pajakan lain; risiko dan ganjaran kekal dengan lessor (1)
Lessor pemilik sah dan benefisial dalam pajakan operasi (1)
Substansi mengatasi bentuk: realiti ekonomi (risiko dan ganjaran) mengatasi hak milik sah (2)

q.en: A lessee signs a 3-year lease with annual payments of RM20,000 at each year-end. The implicit rate is 10% (PV of the three payments is RM49,737). Under the MFRS 16 lessee model, show the initial journal, the year-1 payment journal, and year-1 depreciation (straight-line, no residual).
q.ms: Lessee tandatangan pajakan 3 tahun dengan bayaran tahunan RM20,000 pada setiap hujung tahun. Kadar tersirat 10% (PV tiga bayaran ialah RM49,737). Di bawah model lessee MFRS 16, tunjukkan jurnal awal, jurnal bayaran tahun 1, dan susut nilai tahun 1 (garis lurus, tiada nilai sisa).

en: Dr Right-of-use asset 49,737; Cr Lease liability 49,737 (2)
Dr Interest expense 4,974; Dr Lease liability 15,026; Cr Bank 20,000 (2)
Dr Depreciation expense 16,579; Cr Accumulated depreciation 16,579 (1)
ms: Dr Aset hak guna 49,737; Cr Liabiliti pajakan 49,737 (2)
Dr Belanja faedah 4,974; Dr Liabiliti pajakan 15,026; Cr Bank 20,000 (2)
Dr Belanja susut nilai 16,579; Cr Susut nilai terkumpul 16,579 (1)

q.en: Explain how a lessor accounts for a finance lease and an operating lease.
q.ms: Terangkan bagaimana lessor mengakaunkan pajakan kewangan dan pajakan operasi.

en: Finance lease: recognise lease receivable = net investment at inception (2)
Operating lease: keep and measure the asset by its nature (1)
Expense costs of earning income e.g. depreciation (1)
Lease income straight-line over the lease term (1)
ms: Pajakan kewangan: iktiraf belum terima pajakan = pelaburan bersih pada permulaan (2)
Pajakan operasi: kekalkan dan ukur aset mengikut sifatnya (1)
Belanjakan kos memperoleh pendapatan cth susut nilai (1)
Pendapatan pajakan garis lurus sepanjang tempoh pajakan (1)

q.en: A dealer sells equipment under a finance lease. Fair value RM200,000; PV of minimum lease payments RM190,000; cost RM160,000; PV of unguaranteed residual value RM10,000. Compute sale price, cost of sales, gross profit and the lease receivable.
q.ms: Peniaga menjual peralatan di bawah pajakan kewangan. Nilai saksama RM200,000; PV bayaran pajakan minimum RM190,000; kos RM160,000; PV nilai sisa tidak dijamin RM10,000. Kira harga jualan, kos jualan, untung kasar dan belum terima pajakan.

en: Sale price = lower of FV 200,000 and PV MLP 190,000 = 190,000 (2)
ms: Harga jualan = lebih rendah antara FV 200,000 dan PV MLP 190,000 = 190,000 (2)

q.en: Discuss how IFRS 16 / MFRS 16 changes lease accounting and the issues it addresses.
q.ms: Bincangkan bagaimana IFRS 16 / MFRS 16 mengubah perakaunan pajakan dan isu yang ditanganinya.

en: Single lessee model based on right-of-use (2)
Lessee recognises all leases except short-term and low-value (2)
Must distinguish lease from service contract; subleases (1)
Sale and leaseback must meet the revenue standard (1)
ms: Model lessee tunggal berasaskan hak guna (2)
Lessee mengiktiraf semua pajakan kecuali jangka pendek dan bernilai rendah (2)
Mesti bezakan pajakan daripada kontrak perkhidmatan; sub-pajakan (1)
Jual dan pajak balik mesti memenuhi piawaian hasil (1)

q.en: Does ownership transfer to the lessee by the end of the lease term?
q.ms: Adakah pemilikan berpindah kepada lessee menjelang akhir tempoh pajakan?

q.en: Is a bargain purchase option reasonably certain to be exercised?
q.ms: Adakah opsyen belian murah hampir pasti dilaksanakan?

q.en: Does the lease term cover a major part of the asset's economic life?
q.ms: Adakah tempoh pajakan meliputi sebahagian besar hayat ekonomi aset?

q.en: Is the PV of lease payments substantially all of the asset's fair value?
q.ms: Adakah PV bayaran pajakan hampir keseluruhan nilai saksama aset?

q.en: Is the asset so specialised that only the lessee can use it without major modification?
q.ms: Adakah aset begitu khusus hingga hanya lessee boleh guna tanpa ubah suai besar?

t.en: Finance lease (substantially all risks and rewards transfer)
t.ms: Pajakan kewangan (hampir semua risiko dan ganjaran berpindah)

d.en: Lessor: derecognise asset, lease receivable. Lessee: asset + liability.
d.ms: Lessor: nyahiktiraf aset, belum terima pajakan. Lessee: aset + liabiliti.

d.en: Lessor keeps the asset and recognises straight-line rental income.
d.ms: Lessor kekalkan aset dan iktiraf pendapatan sewa garis lurus.

q.en: Is the lease term 12 months or less (with no purchase option)?
q.ms: Adakah tempoh pajakan 12 bulan atau kurang (tanpa opsyen belian)?

q.en: Is the underlying asset of low value (e.g. a tablet or small office equipment)?
q.ms: Adakah aset asas bernilai rendah (cth tablet atau peralatan pejabat kecil)?

t.en: Recognise a right-of-use asset and a lease liability
t.ms: Iktiraf aset hak guna dan liabiliti pajakan

d.en: Depreciate the ROU asset; unwind interest on the liability.
d.ms: Susutnilaikan aset ROU; iktiraf faedah atas liabiliti.

d.en: Recognise lease payments as an expense over the lease term.
d.ms: Iktiraf bayaran pajakan sebagai belanja sepanjang tempoh pajakan.
